_comment: Per-species ability overrides. Each entry REPLACES the species'
`abilities` field in data/base/pokedex.json with the supplied list.
Used for cases where upstream Showdown encodes the wrong mega
ability (e.g. Mega Golisopod listed as Emergency Exit instead of
Tough Claws) or when the Champions mod's tier table implies a
different ability than what upstream supplies.
Ability names must match upstream's display names exactly (case-
insensitive match is performed in patch_species_abilities.py).
Entries with species ids not in the base pokedex are skipped with
